method: Read-only static review plus pure exported bodyText probe and local evidence-image inspection. No data or validator code changed.
runtimeWaiver: Game iframe real input/clean-context tests intentionally waived; not treated as validation defects.

findings.finding: Additional iframe safety only checks HTTPS and no credentials. It permits localhost, single-label/internal hosts and private/reserved IPs, and never validates sandbox tokens, referrerPolicy, aspectRatio or permissions allowlist.
findings.impact: A future configuration can pass publication with popup/top-navigation privileges or a nonpublic iframe. Gameplay waiver does not waive safe URL configuration.
findings.suggestedFix: Use shared pure URL/player validator with public HTTPS host checks and a small token/permission/referrer allowlist; reject popup/top-navigation tokens and require additional sandbox. Preserve main safe-refusal exception.

findings.finding: Media mode checks three distinct screenshot paths but not screenshot byte hashes, kind=game-capture adopted ledger entries, same-game ownership/task mapping or content-brief/video-analysis links. Video check only counts syntactically valid IDs.
findings.impact: Copies of the same screenshot under three paths or an unrelated video can pass. This is not equivalent to required media evidence.
findings.suggestedFix: Cross-check media-ledger adopted records, stable game ID, capture kind, unique hashes, screenshot slot/question mappings and video-analysis/brief references. Keep actual playback result separate from waived game input tests.

findings.finding: bodyText includes every section heading even when the section contains only post-body video blocks. A pure function probe returns the video-only heading as body text.
findings.impact: A game just below4000 can be incorrectly pushed over the floor by excluded video-section text.
findings.suggestedFix: Filter video-only sections out before extracting headings; use the same definition for rendered DOM and JSON checks. Define whether collapsed FAQ answers are counted based on actual visibility.

findings.impact: Legitimate content published after this date is rejected indefinitely.
findings.suggestedFix: Compute current Asia/Shanghai date from the clock or accept explicit test date through an injected validation context.

findings.finding: Publish mode asserts every entry in games.json and every Guide is published, rather than validating only the published set while retaining valid drafts.
findings.impact: Adding a future draft makes the existing valid production site fail, contrary to draft filtering requirements.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply structural checks to all records, public completeness/media/count checks only to published records or explicit batch-preflight set; published links must resolve only to published targets.

findings.finding: Block validation is partial: nested step/list/FAQ shapes, text ranges, unknown nested fields, array maxima, trimmed plain text and forbidden HTML/third-party addresses are mostly unchecked. Game title/tags/categories and Guide spoilerPolicy/tags/summary limits are incomplete; SEO extra fields are not rejected.
findings.impact: Malformed content may pass the strict-schema gate or fail later inside rendering. Unknown content can enter public JSON despite the documented contract.
findings.suggestedFix: Complete the documented per-block runtime schemas and apply text/array limits consistently; validate nullable draft values without accepting invalid nonempty values.

findings.finding: Game SEO only checks title contains game name; description containment, Guide target keyword, duplicate metadata, static route/TDK ID equality and canonical set equality are not validated here.
findings.impact: Length-correct but mismatched/duplicated metadata can pass.
findings.suggestedFix: Validate final title/description against page-specific target and unique published route registry; use generated canonical sets.

findings.finding: Game covers may use any /images path rather than /images/games; dev mode does not validate nonempty dimensions or alt bounds. Cover hash uniqueness runs only at publish, Guide covers are not checked for cross-Guide duplicate hash, and image src paths are not checked against current game ownership.
findings.impact: Wrong-game or duplicate Guide media may pass relevant stages.
findings.suggestedFix: Validate path namespace and nonempty field ranges in dev; file/dimension/hash/ledger/identity checks in media and publish for each intended record.

findings.finding: Validator never loads keyword-video-map, game/guide-content-briefs, game-claim-matrix, page-content-blueprints or site-capabilities identities. authorId is blanket required null rather than resolved against verified identity records.
findings.impact: Missing claim/brief/media traceability or a valid future verified author cannot be handled according to the documented data flow.
findings.suggestedFix: Add reference-integrity checks with exact stable IDs and verified author lookup; leave research wording out of public data.
